title: Cinematic Kinetic-Type Lyric Essay (AI / P(doom))
summary: A 2.5 min cinematic lyric video for a song about AI (sung vocals: 'I see sparks...', 'Your circuits make me nervous'). Near-black film-grade frames with a single burnt-orange glow accent: lyrics karaoke-highlight word-by-word over glowing vector line art (a TikZ unicorn, contour tunnels, black holes), terminal prompt boxes typing 'Chat|', 3D wireframe rooms, sculpted 'shoggoth' renders, odometers counting to 1E30 FLOP/s, and torn paper diagrams. Dense, nerdy, art-film quality.
fit_reason: Gorgeous craft but dark, ominous and dense; the single-accent karaoke lyric technique and terminal prompt motif are borrowable, the mood is not.

palette.mood: dark cinematic, film grain and vignette, burnt-orange glow as the only colour; occasional paper-white interludes

typography.display: mix: ultra-heavy wide grotesk caps (Archivo Black/Expanded), monospace terminal (JetBrains Mono), serif italic for whispered lines
typography.case: mixed (upper for impact words, sentence for lyrics)
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: frame-filling single words (I'M, AGI, SERVANT) alternating with small lyric lines and tiny HUD annotations
typography.notes: Active lyric word turns orange #f65921 while the rest is grey/white; type often warped onto 3D surfaces (curved around a black hole, mirrored upside down, extruded).

text_animation: karaoke word-by-word colour fill (white → orange) synced to vocals
typewriter in terminal prompt box with orange caret and autocomplete probability list
text wrapped on 3D paths / curved around shapes
captions: karaoke highlight — lyric lines placed in-scene (not fixed position), no box, active word burnt orange #f65921, upcoming words grey with low opacity
motion: slow camera dolly through glowing line-art and contour tunnels
vector strokes draw on with glowing head
graphic_elements: terminal prompt box with next-token probability table
ui_treatment: Stylised terminal/chat prompt box (mono, orange caret, top-k token list with bars); no product UI.

sound.music: original song with sung vocals, moody electronic/indie, ~90-100 bpm
sound.sync: every lyric word timed to the vocal; big words hit on downbeats

signature_moves: single burnt-orange accent on near-black, word-by-word karaoke
terminal prompt typing 'Chat|' with next-token probability panel
lyrics warped onto 3D geometry (curved round black hole, mirrored)
frame-filling single-word slams between quiet lines

best_segments.what: Terminal prompt types 'Chat|' with orange caret and next-token probability table over a contour tunnel

recreate.how: Mostly After Effects/Cinema 4D-grade; type and terminal scenes doable in Remotion/GSAP with word-timed captions, SVG stroke glow, grain overlay. 3D creatures and tunnels need 3D renders.
recreate.prompt: Dark cinematic lyric video, near-black with film grain and one burnt-orange glow: lyrics highlight word by word in orange over glowing vector line art, a mono terminal prompt types with an orange caret and next-token probabilities, single huge words slam full-frame.
